retryDecidedByClient.why: toAppError infers the code and the retryable flag from substrings of the message text, so a server that answered retryable:false is overruled whenever its sentence happens to contain the word timeout.
retryDecidedByClient.fix: read the code and the retryable flag off the error envelope the route returned, and fall back to isRetryableErrorCode from error-taxonomy rather than to the message text.

retryDecidedByClient.why: the query client retries anything that is not a 4xx three times, so a rate limit is abandoned after one attempt and a refused policy that answered 503 is hammered.
retryDecidedByClient.fix: retry on the envelope's retryable flag, which classifyErrorCode derives from the class the server decided on.
